name: nodeforge
description: Autonomous Node.js/TypeScript engineering workspace — orchestration core for VS Code and Cursor.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Workspace inspection, configuration display, and read-only diagnostics run in Restricted Mode. Running commands, tests, processes, and agent execution require Workspace Trust.

commands.title: NodeForge: Run Tests from Current File

nodeforge.runtime.preferredNodeBinary.description: Optional absolute path to a Node binary used for spawned commands. If empty, NodeForge uses PATH resolution.

nodeforge.diagnostics.aggressiveRefresh.description: If true, refresh diagnostics on every file save instead of debouncing.

nodeforge.chat.baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL for NodeForge chat.

nodeforge.chat.maxToolRounds.description: Maximum tool-call rounds per chat message.

nodeforge.chat.injectWorkspaceSnapshot.description: Inject workspace profile and dependency summaries into each chat turn.

nodeforge.dependencies.backgroundAudit.description: Run dependency audit when package.json or lockfiles change (trusted workspaces).

nodeforge.dependencies.backgroundGraphAn.description: Analyze dependency graph (unused/circular/missing) on activation and when package.json changes (trusted workspaces).

nodeforge.workspace.followActiveEditor.description: In multi-root workspaces, switch NodeForge's active folder to the folder of the focused editor. Off by default; use “NodeForge: Select Workspace Folder” otherwise.

nodeforge.debug.loadDotEnv.markdownDescription: Inject variables from the workspace `.env` into NodeForge-resolved debug sessions (trusted workspaces only). Off by default; variable names are logged, values never are.

nodeforge.docs.preferExternal.description: Open DevDocs in the system browser instead of the embedded Docs sidebar view.

nodeforge.docs.offline.autoSync.description: Download DevDocs docsets for the detected workspace stack after activation (network required).

nodeforge.docs.offline.preferOfflineSear.description: When synced docsets exist, search offline first and open local HTML pages.

nodeforge.docs.offline.extraSlugs.description: Additional DevDocs slugs to include when syncing (e.g. react, express).

nodeforge.ollama.baseUrl.description: Ollama server base URL. Use a URL such as http://localhost:11434 for a local server.

nodeforge.mcp.allowExecution.description: Let the bundled NodeForge MCP server run project tooling (tsc, linters, tests). Only offered in trusted workspaces.

nodeforge.mcp.allowWrites.description: Let the bundled NodeForge MCP server run mutating tools (scripts, formatters, auto-fix).

nodeforge.mcp.allowNetwork.description: Let the bundled NodeForge MCP server run network-dependent tools (dependency audit).

steps.title: Analyze Your Workspace
steps.description:
NodeForge detects your runtime, package manager, linter, formatter, test runner, ORM, and more.
[Analyze Workspace](command:nodeforge.analyzeWorkspace)

media.markdown:
Open any Node.js/TypeScript project and NodeForge will automatically detect:

- **Runtime**: Node, Bun, or Deno
- **Package Manager**: npm, pnpm, or yarn
- **Linter**: ESLint or Biome
- **Formatter**: Prettier or Biome
- **Test Runner**: Vitest, Jest, or Node test
- **ORM**: Prisma or Drizzle
- **Infrastructure**: Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions

The profile appears in the **Workspace** view in the NodeForge sidebar.

steps.title: Run Diagnostics
steps.description:
Get TypeScript + ESLint/Biome findings with squigglies in the editor and entries in the Problems panel.
[Run Diagnostics](command:nodeforge.runDiagnostics)

media.markdown:
NodeForge bridges diagnostics from all your tools into VS Code's native Problems panel:

- **TypeScript** compiler errors
- **ESLint** or **Biome** lint findings
- Editor squigglies (red/yellow/blue)
- F8 / Shift+F8 navigation
- Status bar error count

Click the lightbulb (💡) for Quick Fixes like "Apply ESLint --fix" or "Disable rule on this line".

steps.title: Run Tests
steps.description:
Run Vitest, Jest, or Node test with native Test Explorer integration.
[Run Tests](command:nodeforge.runTests)

media.markdown:
NodeForge integrates with VS Code's Test Explorer:

- Gutter glyphs (✓ green check / ✗ red X)
- "Run Test" code lenses above `it()` calls
- Per-test status icons
- Click a test to jump to its source

Use `Debug Test` to debug a single test with breakpoints.

steps.title: Configure the MCP Agent
steps.description:
Enable AI agents (Cursor, Claude Code) to read your workspace and take actions.
[Show Agent Setup](command:nodeforge.refresh)

steps.title: Explore More Features
steps.description: Dependency graph, ER diagrams, runtime terminals, git state, and more.

media.markdown:
**Explore the sidebar views:**

| View | What it shows |
|------|----------------|
| Workspace | Detected profile |
| Diagnostics | Live findings |
| Tests | Test suite tree |
| Runtime | Running processes |
| Git | Branch, dirty status, files |
| Database | Schema (Prisma/Drizzle) |
| Dependencies | Vulnerabilities + outdated |
| Agent | MCP server setup |

**Try these commands:**
- `NodeForge: Show Dependency Graph` — interactive import graph
- `NodeForge: Show Database Schema` — ER diagram
- `NodeForge: Start Dev Server` — launch in a real terminal
- `NodeForge: Audit Dependencies` — vulnerability scan

languageModelTools.name: nodeforge_get_project_context
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the detected Node.js and TypeScript workspace profile, including runtime, package manager, compiler, linting, formatting, tests, ORM, infrastructure, and monorepo signals. Read-only.

languageModelTools.name: nodeforge_get_diagnostics
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run TypeScript plus the detected ESLint or Biome checks and return normalized diagnostics. Requires Workspace Trust because project tooling is executed.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Inspect current compiler and lint findings.

languageModelTools.name: nodeforge_run_typecheck
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run the workspace TypeScript compiler with no emit and return normalized type errors. Requires Workspace Trust because the project compiler is executed.

languageModelTools.name: nodeforge_run_linter
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run the detected project linter and return normalized findings. Requires Workspace Trust because project tooling is executed.

languageModelTools.name: nodeforge_get_tests
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run the detected Vitest or Jest suite and return per-test results, failures, locations, and durations. Requires Workspace Trust because project code is executed.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Run tests and inspect per-test outcomes.

languageModelTools.name: nodeforge_get_git_diff
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the current Git diff so changes can be reviewed with their real patch context. Scope can be working, staged, or head-vs-upstream. Read-only.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Inspect actual code changes before reviewing or modifying them.

languageModelTools.name: nodeforge_get_dependency_graph
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Analyze imports and declared dependencies, reporting unused, circular, and missing dependencies. Read-only.

languageModelTools.name: nodeforge_get_dependency_report
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run package-manager audit and outdated checks and return dependency vulnerability and version findings. Requires Workspace Trust and network capability because package-manager commands are executed.

languageModelTools.name: nodeforge_get_database_schema
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the detected Prisma or Drizzle schema and return tables, columns, indexes, and relations. Read-only.

languageModelTools.name: nodeforge_run_script
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run one existing package.json script using the detected package manager. This executes project code and may modify files or start processes; confirmation is required.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Execute a package.json script with confirmation.

args.description: Optional arguments passed to the script.

languageModelTools.name: nodeforge_format_workspace
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Format workspace files using the detected Prettier or Biome configuration. This changes files; confirmation is required.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Format workspace files with the project's formatter.

languageModelTools.name: nodeforge_validate_workspace
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run TypeScript, linting, tests, and dependency audit as an engineering verification pass. Prefer this after changes before declaring a task complete.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Run the full engineering verification pass.

languageModelTools.name: nodeforge_read_file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read a workspace source file (text only, up to about 200 KB per call). Pass startLine/endLine (1-based, inclusive) for large files; the result includes totalLines and a truncated flag. Secrets (.env, keys, credentials), .git and node_modules are refused. Read-only.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read a source file from the workspace.

languageModelTools.name: nodeforge_search_code
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search workspace source text for a literal string, or a JavaScript regular expression when regex is true. Returns up to maxResults matches (default 50, max 100) with workspace-relative path, 1-based line and a trimmed snippet. Skips node_modules, .git, build output, binaries and secret files. Read-only.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Search the workspace source for text.

regex.description: Treat the query as a regular expression.

extensions.description: Only search these file extensions, e.g. [".ts"].

languageModelTools.name: nodeforge_apply_patch
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Edit workspace files with exact-match replacements, applied atomically: if any edit is invalid nothing is written. Each edit replaces oldText, which must occur exactly once in the file at that point (include enough context), with newText. An empty oldText creates a new file that must not exist yet. Read the file first and copy text exactly. Secrets, .git and node_modules are refused. Modifies files on disk; confirmation is required.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Edit workspace source files with confirmation.

edits.description: One or more edits (max 50), applied in order.

oldText.description: Exact existing text to replace, or an empty string to create the file.

newText.description: Replacement text, or the full content of a new file.
